name: residenz-aureum
description: Site statique bilingue de Residenz Aureum.

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-media.mjs --mode preview && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/validate-content.mjs --mode preview && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/validate-foundation.mjs --source
scripts.validate:production: node scripts/validate-media.mjs --mode production && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/validate-content.mjs --mode production
scripts.audit: npm run audit:a11y && npm run audit:seo && npm run audit:performance
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:preview && npm run audit && npm run audit:security
scripts.check:production: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:production && npm run audit && npm run audit:security
